newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhstan to issue Samurai in summer - official.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan to issue Samurai in summer - official.

text.p: The head of Kazakhstan's National Securities Commission said on Thursday that the oil-rich Central Asian republic will raise $200 to $250 million with a yen-denominated Samurai bond this summer.
"It has been decided officially to issue a Samurai bond," Grigory Marchenko told Reuters in an interview. The former Soviet republic successfully placed a debut $200 million Eurobond in December.
